abstract: Traditional simulations of parametric partial differential equations (PDEs) rely on repetitive computations for each parameter, which makes high-fidelity design impractical. Neural operators address this issue by learning solution operators, accelerating parameter-space mapping by orders of magnitude. Recent Transformer-based neural operators attempt to capture global dependencies, but often at the cost of quadratic attention complexity. Transolver resolves this problem by projecting physical states into a reduced slice space for attention computation. Although fast, this projection sacrifices fine spatial information. Moreover, by operating in this reduced space with shared weights across attention heads, it may constrain the model's flexibility, thereby limiting its capacity to capture complex phenomena. To address these issues, we propose the Cluster Attention Neural Operator (CANO), which reformulates attention via a novel cross-attention mechanism that dynamically clusters queries while preserving full-resolution keys and values. This avoids slice compression loss and removes weight-sharing limits. At the same time, the model remains fast without losing global interactions. Empirically, CANO achieves state-of-the-art performance across canonical PDE benchmarks, covering fluid and solid dynamics (e.g., Navier-Stokes, Airfoil, Plasticity), irregular unstructured geometries (e.g., Pipe Turbulence, Composites), and long-term temporal rollouts. Across solid deformation and turbulent flow benchmarks, CANO achieves lower errors than baselines and exhibits strong geometric adaptability and temporal consistency.

title: Inverting the geodesic ray transform with finite measurements: stability and reconstruction
authors: Yernat M. Assylbekov
abstract: We study the inversion of the geodesic ray transform from finitely many local averages of its data. Under suitable geometric assumptions, we prove Lipschitz stability on any fixed finite-dimensional reconstruction space when the measurement partition is sufficiently fine. We develop convergent reconstruction algorithms based on Steepest Gradient Descent and Conjugate Gradients and implement them using piecewise constant finite element spaces. Numerical experiments in 2D and 3D illustrate the influence of geometry and measurement discretization on reconstruction quality.

title: Separating Notions of Graph Width: the Adaptive, Normal, Linear, Entropic, and Submodular Width
authors: Matthias Lanzinger, Timo Camillo Merkl, Dan Suciu
abstract: We describe one explicit simple graph G on 32 vertices whose adaptive, normal, linear, entropic, and submodular widths are pairwise distinct. We compute all these widths exactly, except for the entropic width, where we only give a lower and upper bound. We use Ingleton's inequality and the Zhang-Yeung inequality for upper bounds, and give explicit constructions of modular, normal, linear, entropic, and non-entropic polymatroids for lower bounds.

title: PINNing the pion: conformal deep learning for $F_π(s)$ and the $(g-2)_μ$ hadronic contribution
authors: Mayank Goel, Subhadip Mitra, Monalisa Patra
abstract: Extracting the pion electromagnetic form factor $F_π(s)$ through phenomenological curve-fitting models introduces model dependence, unphysical artefacts, and kinematic inconsistencies. We introduce a Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) embedded in a conformal $z$-plane that constructs $F_π(s)$ directly from first principles across spacelike and timelike domains: charge normalisation and Schwarz reflection are enforced by construction, while Cauchy-Riemann analyticity, dispersion relations, Watson's theorem, and perturbative QCD asymptotics enter through the loss functional. Thus, the fundamental S-matrix principles dictate the form factor's behaviour while data act as constraints. Mapping the cut complex plane onto the unit disk bounds the Hessian norm and prevents Neural Tangent Kernel spectral starvation, two known failure modes of deep-learning optimisation. Besides $e^+e^-$ scattering data, we also incorporate $τ$-decay data through a switch that isolates the pure isovector form factor natively, bypassing model-dependent isospin-breaking pre-corrections. The network organically yields an interior zero-free form factor, while the framework tests experimental tensions around the $ρ(770)$ peak against analyticity and dispersion constraints. We obtain model-independent estimates of the pion charge radius, $\langle r_π^2 \rangle = 0.435 \pm 0.008_{\text{stat}} \pm 0.007_{\text{cali}}$ fm$^2$, the second-sheet pole parameters, $m_ρ^{\text{pole}} = 761.72\pm 1.04$ MeV and $Γ_ρ^{\text{pole}} = 135.99 \pm 1.20$ MeV, and the two-pion contribution to the muon anomalous magnetic moment, $a_μ^{ππ} = (506.48 \pm 2.02_{\text{stat}} \pm 1.70_{\text{cali}}) \times 10^{-10}$.

title: Computing Extinction Barriers in a Quorum-Sensing Reaction Network
authors: Mario Ayala, Johannes Zimmer
abstract: We introduce a simple reaction-network model of a quorum-sensing population that couples the cell density $x$ to the signal density $w$. In the four-channel cell-signal network studied here, scaling signal production and removal by the same factor $r$ leaves all deterministic equilibria, and their stability types, unchanged. Nevertheless, we show that $r$ shifts the quasipotential barrier $ΔV(r)$ for rare transitions towards extinction, and thus, under metastable exit assumptions, the mean time to reach a fixed neighbourhood of the extinction state on the exponential scale $e^{NΔV(r)}$. We compute the barrier by minimization of the path action with the signal retained as a fluctuating coordinate, and we compare it with exact stochastic simulation of population-threshold crossing times regressed in $N$. Over a range of $r$, the minimum-action barriers satisfy $ΔV(r)=ΔV_\infty+O(1/r)$, where $ΔV_\infty$ is obtained by eliminating the signal first. At $r=1$, the barrier is 55% larger than $ΔV_\infty$. The saddle barrier $ΔV(r)$ is also the least action needed to enter the basin of extinction, but the density threshold can be crossed more cheaply: at $r=0.5$ the cheapest crossing costs 7.7% less action, keeps the signal high, and is usually followed by recovery. Simulated arrival times in this neighbourhood, which include failed attempts, grow with slopes within two fitted standard errors of the saddle barrier at every tested rate, and within $0.004$ of it if the logarithmic prefactor term is omitted. Under either regression model they exclude $ΔV_\infty$ at $r\le2$ by at least $4.4$ fitted standard errors, without using the action solver.
comment: 26 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to the MMSC 2026 proceedings (EPiC Series in Computing). Code and data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23062342

title: Amortized Bayesian Inference on Multilevel Models of Arbitrary Structure
authors: Daniel Habermann, Andreas Bulling, Stefan T. Radev, Paul-Christian Bürkner
abstract: We develop a general method for amortized Bayesian inference on multilevel models of arbitrary structure. Given a generative model specified as a directed acyclic graph, our method automatically derives valid factorizations of the joint posterior and matching neural network architectures. The key steps, graph expansion and graph inversion, yield an inverse graph that determines how inference networks are stacked and conditioned, producing factorizations that amortize over the number of groups and the number of observations within each group. Unlike approaches that simplify the dependency structure to speed up learning or inference, our method preserves all conditional independence and exchangeability assumptions of the generative model. Across three case studies, it closely matches gold-standard samplers on models with more than 6,500 parameters while reducing inference to a near-instant forward pass once trained.

title: MAGiDiff: Sampling the Photospheric Vector Field from UV/EUV Filtergrams
authors: Ruoyu Wang, David Fouhey
abstract: Photospheric vector magnetic fields are foundational to modeling, understanding, and forecasting solar activity. These data are usually produced by inverting and disambiguating the full Stokes vector at multiple passbands, which is demanding. Here, we investigate how well we can estimate photospheric vector magnetograms from UV/EUV filtergrams. This problem is challenging and intrinsically ambiguous without polarization information, as the mapping from UV/EUV intensity to the magnetic field is indirect and ill-posed. We introduce MAGiDiff, a machine-learning-based method that uses denoising diffusion models to estimate vector magnetograms from UV/EUV filtergrams. As input, MAGiDiff takes a stack of filtergrams from the Solar Dynamics Observatory (SDO) / Atmospheric Imaging Assembly (AIA); as output, it is trained to estimate the disambiguated vector magnetogram as seen by Hinode / Solar Optical Telescope-Spectro-Polarimeter (SOT-SP). We show that MAGiDiff can accurately mimic the Hinode ground-truth. Additionally, we probe MAGiDiff's understanding of the physical structure and magnetic connectivity. On full-disk, we show that it produces plausible structures for active regions. MAGiDiff generalizes across solar cycles despite hemispheric polarity reversal, and can be fine-tuned to other EUV instruments including STEREO/EUVI and GOES-R/SUVI. While clearly not a substitute for a dedicated instrument, MAGiDiff opens the door to new capabilities.

title: Proximal Balancing for Causal Effect Estimation under Unmeasured Confounding
authors: Yonghan Jung
abstract: Estimating causal effects from observational data is central to science and policy, but the effects are not identified when confounders are unmeasured. Proximal causal inference addresses this problem with proxies of the unmeasured confounders. However, existing proxy-based approaches either designate proxy roles and solve an inverse problem, which is ill-posed and hard to estimate with high-dimensional proxies, or use a latent-variable model, which assumes that the learned latent variable matches the hidden confounder and leaves bias when it does not. To address these challenges, we introduce proximal balancing. It carries the classical idea of covariate balancing to confounders that are observed only through proxies: it learns a low-dimensional summary of the covariates and proxies that makes the treatment groups comparable, and then adjusts for this summary. It needs no designated proxy roles, inverse problem, or latent model. We give identification theory, finite-sample guarantees, and a practical algorithm, PROBE. We demonstrate the method on low-dimensional, high-dimensional, and image proxies and on real-world data.

title: A Fourier-Label Information-Loss Barrier for Dihedral Coset Algorithms
authors: Aparna Gupte, Seyoon Ragavan, Mark Zhandry
abstract:
We establish a no-go theorem for a broad class of quantum algorithms for the dihedral coset problem (DCP). We consider the Fourier-sampling and subset-sum-measurement template proposed by Regev (SIAM Journal on Computing, 2004), which is one of the main approaches to solving DCP. Suppose that, after measuring the lower $n-1$ bits of the subset sum, the algorithm discards any $ω(\log n)$ bits from each of the Fourier labels. Then we prove that the algorithm cannot succeed in solving DCP. This shows that any algorithm following this template must make extensive use of the Fourier labels, and thus serves as a useful guide for developing algorithms for DCP.
  As a main application, we show that the recent algorithm by Simon (IACR ePrint:2026/1591, August 11 2026) does not solve DCP. We show that after the subset-sum measurement, this algorithm can be implemented (up to exponentially-small error) using only the most-significant third of the Fourier labels, and is therefore subject to our general no-go theorem. To help with verifiability, we release Lean 4 code for our results.

title: Equality in the Bosonic Quantum Entropy Power Inequality
authors: Yonglong Li
abstract: The bosonic quantum entropy power inequality bounds the entropy of a beam-splitter output in terms of the input entropies. We determine its complete equality class among independent inputs of finite mean photon number: for any number of modes and any transmissivity strictly between zero and one, equality in either the linear or the exponential form holds if and only if the inputs are Gaussian with the same covariance matrix, allowing arbitrary displacements. The main step shows that equality for one output forces the two outputs to be independent: a thermal auxiliary converts equality into preservation of mutual information by a fixed noisy channel, and a two-outcome instrument shows that preservation of mutual information requires a product state with the reference. The quantum Darmois--Skitovich theorem then gives Gaussianity, while a central-limit argument reduces exponential equality to linear equality.

title: Universal Entanglement Distillation
authors: Salvatore Tirone, Francesco Anna Mele, Vittorio Giovannetti, Ludovico Lami
abstract: We present a universal entanglement distillation protocol that asymptotically achieves the distillable entanglement of any unknown bipartite state in a fixed finite dimension. That is, its ebit yield attains every rate below the optimum that would be available if the state were known, with vanishing trace-distance error. Our approach combines tomography by local operations and classical communication with an adaptive distillation routine, using a local robustness lemma to control finite-sample estimation errors. We also characterize worst-case distillation from a family of states: the optimal uniform rate is the minimum distillable entanglement on the family's closure. These results show that ignorance of the state need not incur an asymptotic rate penalty.
comment: 33 pages, 1 figure. See also the independent work by Takagi et al., which appeared on the arXiv today

title: Grounding Time-Series Foundation Models in Digital Twin Topology for Predictive Maintenance
authors: Sizhe Ma, Katherine A. Flanigan, Mario Bergés
abstract: Digital twins increasingly support downstream analytical tasks that depend on time-series data, motivating interest in time-series foundation models (TSFMs) as scalable backbones. However, TSFMs are primarily pretrained for temporal continuation and often underperform on unseen tasks such as regression, and systematic empirical comparisons against state-of-the-art dedicated models in digital twin contexts remain limited. This paper makes three contributions. First, we benchmark five well-known TSFMs with frozen backbones on remaining useful life (RUL) prediction using the C-MAPSS dataset, finding that multivariate architectures substantially outperform univariate ones, particularly under varying operating conditions. This raises a deeper question: when cross-channel dependencies can be modeled through pretrained weights, target-task adaptation, and digital twin-derived representations, how much does each contribute, and are they complementary? Second, we propose a topology-informed fusion approach in which topological constraints, derived from the asset structure the digital twin stores among its information models, explicitly shape cross-attention, so that fused representations respect the physical system's local connectivity rather than relying on unconstrained all-to-all interactions. Third, we conduct an ablation study across C-MAPSS subsets of varying operational complexity that isolates the three sources and their interactions. The sources prove complementary rather than redundant, and topology-constrained attention outperforms unconstrained fusion, though by a small margin, enabling a frozen TSFM informed by digital twin representations to remain competitive or in some cases exceed state-of-the-art performance on this regression task.
comment: Submitted to Reliability Engineering \& System Safety (RESS)

title: Tissue Detection Determines False Positives in Diffusion-Based Histopathology Artifact Detection
authors: Konstantinos Moutselos, Ilias Maglogiannis
abstract: One-class artifact detectors for whole-slide images learn normal tissue from a clean training pool and flag departures from it. The pool is built by a preprocessing pipeline whose tissue-detection step is usually treated as neutral. We tested whether it is. On 16 annotated TCGA slides, we rebuilt the clean pool of a diffusion-based detector with different tissue detection methods and compared the resulting models in a four-fold cross-validation. Per-slide saturation-Otsu detection excluded normal tissue, chiefly tissue with large clear spaces such as adipose tissue and alveolar parenchyma, and on slides with thick marker ink kept the ink while excluding ordinary tissue. Replacing it with entropy-based detection reduced the false-positive fraction on held-out clean slides from 0.102 to 0.016, in every fold and with a second training seed, without loss of sensitivity; the gain came from the composition of the pool, not its size. Across three tissue detection methods, false positives followed the fraction of such clear-space tissue in the pool, a statistic that needs no labels or training (0.103, 0.016 and 0.009). The effect did not carry over at the same size to a nearest-neighbour detector on foundation-model features. On an external cohort, the curated pool lowered clean-control false positives by about 20%, far less than within TCGA, and the remaining cross-center loss was not explained by stain differences. For one-class quality control, tissue detection decides what the model learns as normal and should be chosen and reported accordingly.
comment: 29 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables, including supplementary material. Submitted to Computerized Medical Imaging and Graphics. Code, data and models: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23016733

title: Super-Quadratic Quantum Speedups for Combinatorial Optimization via Tilted Walks
authors: Guneykan Ozgul, Shouvanik Chakrabarti
abstract: We introduce quantum tilted walks, a quantum algorithmic framework for solving exact combinatorial optimization problems. The framework applies an average of powers of a tilted Hamiltonian that biases the discriminant matrix of a base Markov chain (mixer) with the objective function. Our starting point is quantum short-path algorithms, which prepare the ground state of such a Hamiltonian and obtain super-quadratic speedups over exhaustive search for certain combinatorial optimization problems. Recently, Le Gall and Tamaki~(arXiv:2604.12131) developed a classical conditioning-and-search algorithm for weighted MAX-E$k$-LIN2 and weighted MAX-$k$-CSP. Under the same assumptions, their algorithm is only sub-quadratically slower than quantum short-path algorithms. Consequently, existing short-path algorithms do not establish a super-quadratic speedup over this stronger classical baseline. For maximization problems, we give conditions under which tilted walks increase the amplitude on the target state with high objective value when initialized from a starting state with lower objective value. This framework captures conditioning-and-search and yields super-quadratic speedups over it for the same problems. While our framework recovers quantum short-path algorithms as a special case, it neither requires ground-state preparation nor initialization in the ground state of the base mixer. We demonstrate these advantages on a synthetic optimization problem for which tilted walks achieve a super-quadratic speedup whereas the short-path algorithms do not.

title: Less is more: error-distance scaling relation for data-efficient kilometer-scale downscaling of extreme heat
authors: Ahmed Marey, Henry Lu, Abhishek Gaur, Liangzhu Leon Wang, Sherif Goubran, Malek Aloui, Theodore Potsis, Alex Hernandez-Garcia, David Rolnick
abstract: Extreme heat is where urban adaptation needs kilometer-scale data the most, but the simulations training a downscaler can cost more than they save, and how much is needed has not been identified. We measured it with CASPER, a U-Net with a structure-preserving loss downscaling 32 km reanalysis to 1 km temperature, humidity and wind, across 24 configurations of one to eight months. Held-out error grows linearly with climatological distance to the training data, RMSE = 0.83 + 2.95 d, explaining 90% of its variance against 7% for volume and predicting unseen months in advance. On held-out extreme summer weeks CASPER preserves the fine-scale structure and cross-variable physics that matched-budget baselines degrade, and matches station observations during documented heat waves to within 1.8 K. Transfer to a new region degrades geographically; 11 days of local simulation cuts Vancouver's held-out error from 3.8 to 1.3 K. Training periods should span the target climate: the same accuracy for four times less simulation, putting kilometer-scale downscaling of extreme heat within reach of groups without large computing facilities.

title: adapol: Adaptive pole-fitting for quantum many-body physics
authors: Zhen Huang, Chia-Nan Yeh, Lin Lin, Nils Wentzell, Jason Kaye, Hugo U. R. Strand
abstract: We describe adapol, a Python package for fitting Matsubara Green's functions, self-energies, and hybridization functions by a compact sum of simple poles with real pole locations and matrix-valued residues. This pole-fitting step arises in many contexts, including hybridization fitting for quantum impurity solvers based on exact diagonalization, perturbation theory, and tensor networks, the compression of existing pole expansions such as the discrete Lehmann representation, diagrammatic methods based on discrete pole representations, and the analytic continuation of Matsubara Green's functions. adapol uses a modified version of the AAA rational approximation algorithm to estimate pole locations, and non-convex optimization to refine them. This procedure yields accurate and compact fits in a black-box and noise-robust manner. adapol provides a simple, self-contained interface with extensive documentation and examples, as well as an interface to the TRIQS package.

title: Quantum Černý complexity of binary words
authors: Pui Hang Lee, Pui-Yee Lee, Bjørn Kjos-Hanssen
abstract: We introduce the quantum Černý complexity $\mathrm{qc}(w)$ of a binary word $w$: the least dimension $d$ for which there exist quantum channels $A_0,A_1$ on $d\times d$ density matrices and a start state $ρ_0$ such that $w$ is the unique shortest word whose associated channel is constant on the reachable set. We show that $2\le\mathrm{qc}(w)\le\lceil\sqrt{|w|+1}\,\rceil$ for every nonempty $w$, a quadratic saving over the classical analogue, and that constant words are extremal: $\mathrm{qc}(0^m)=\lceil\sqrt{m+1}\,\rceil$. In contrast, $\mathrm{qc}(01^n0)=2$ for every $n\ge 1$, realized by a single qubit whose rotation angle acts as a counter; consequently there is no quantum analogue of the Černý function, and $\mathrm{qc}$ is strongly anti-correlated with intuitive notions of descriptive complexity. We further study the variant $\mathrm{qcp}$ in which the synchronization target is required to be a pure state. We prove that in dimension $2$ no word of length at least $2$ can be a unique shortest synchronizing word with pure target, and we exhibit an explicit qutrit instance, combining a coherent rotation with a measure-and-funnel channel, achieving $\mathrm{qcp}(01^n0)=3$ with target a computational basis state and with synchronization holding universally over all input states. Thus purity of the reset state costs exactly one dimension on this family. We also observe that $\mathrm{qc}$ is computable, by reduction to the first-order theory of the reals.

title: EndoWake: Modeling Wind by Linear Programming for Wind Farm Layout Optimization
authors: Martina Fischetti, Matteo Fischetti
abstract: The Wind Farm Layout Optimization problem consists of placing a given number of turbines within a given area so as to maximize energy production. One of its main challenges is the wake effect between turbines, which can strongly affect production and is a cumbersome function to evaluate and to embed in an optimization framework. In this paper we introduce a new endogenous wake model (EndoWake), based on the idea of treating the wind speed at every grid point as a decision variable, linked to its upwind neighbors through linear propagation constraints. This makes it possible to incorporate the wake equations directly into a Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) model. We then develop such a MILP model and, in particular, introduce a new class of valid "band" inequalities, showing that they substantially strengthen the root bound. Building on this, we design a branch-and-check scheme: the master problem retains only the site variables together with one hypograph variable per cell and scenario, integer solutions are evaluated by an exact linear-time oracle, and the optimality cuts are problem-specific "upwind cuts". Computational results are reported on a ladder of square grids under a four-sector axial wind rose, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed improvements.
comment: 30 pages + 12 pages of supplementary material (appended after the references). Replication package: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22017424

title: Improved Quantum Query Bounds for Boolean Matrix Product Verification
authors: Amin Shiraz Gilani, François Le Gall, Xingyu Zhou
abstract:
We prove the first non-trivial upper bound for the quantum query complexity of Boolean Matrix Product Verification ($\mathsf{BMPV}$), answering a longstanding open question in quantum query complexity. For $n\times n$ matrices, our upper bound is $\widetilde O(n^{17/12})$, improving on the standard $O(n^{3/2})$ bound obtained using Grover search by Buhrman and Špalek (SODA 2006). We complement this result by showing an $Ω(n^{5/4})$ lower bound, which improves over the previous best known lower bound of $\widetildeΩ(n^{19/18})$ by Childs, Kimmel, and Kothari (ESA 2012).
  Our approach centers on a connection with Orthogonal Vectors ($\mathsf{OV}$), which asks whether an indexed list of $n$ Boolean vectors of dimension $n$ contains two vectors with disjoint supports. In particular, we prove equivalences between $\mathsf{OV}$ and $\mathsf{BMPV}$ and establish the above bounds for $\mathsf{OV}$. We also prove a tight $\widetilde Θ(n^{3/2})$ bound for a variant of $\mathsf{BMPV}$ that asks whether the product contains a given row vector. Together, these results imply a polynomial separation between the quantum query complexities of deciding whether a graph has radius at most two and whether it has diameter at most two.

title: Shadow Quantum Singular Value Transformation with Shallow Quantum Circuits
authors: Nai-Hui Chia, Hyunseong Kim, Chia-Ying Lin
abstract:
We introduce shadow quantum singular value transformation (Shadow QSVT): given an initial state $|ψ\rangle$, a Hermitian matrix $H$, a polynomial $f$, and a set of observables $\{O_1,\dots,O_m\}$, the goal is to estimate $\langleψ|f(H)^{\dagger}O_j f(H)|ψ\rangle$ for all $j\in\{1,\dots,m\}$. Shadow QSVT provides a systematic route to reduce the quantum resources required by standard QSVT, which constructs a unitary block-encoding of $f(H)$. It uses structure in the input state and observables, together with the fact that many applications require only observable estimates rather than synthesizing the full unitary.
  We present three algorithms that exploit structure in the initial state and observables to reduce quantum circuit depth. First, we develop a state-aware QSVT algorithm that prepares the target state with low circuit depth when the Krylov subspace associated with $H$ and $|ψ\rangle$ is low-dimensional or admits an accurate low-dimensional approximation. Second, we introduce an observable-aware Shadow QSVT algorithm that combines a new observable-aware Krylov subspace with history states to further reduce circuit depth and gate complexity. Finally, we develop Classical Shadow QSVT, which constructs a classical representation from $H$, $f$, and $|ψ\rangle$ without prior knowledge of the observables or explicit preparation of the target state proportional to $f(H)|ψ\rangle$. This representation enables estimation of the target quantities for observables specified after the quantum computation. Together, these three algorithms provide tools for reducing the circuit depth of QSVT-based computations across a range of settings.

translation:
我们引入了影子量子奇异值变换（Shadow QSVT）：给定一个初始态$|ψangle$、一个厄米矩阵$H$、一个多项式$f$以及一组可观测量$O_1,	extdots,O_m$，目标是估计所有$j	ext{∈}{1,	extdots,m}$的$	ext{〈}ψ|f(H)^{	ext{†}}O_j f(H)|ψ	ext{〉}$。影子QSVT提供了一种系统性的方法来减少标准QSVT所需的量子资源，标准QSVT会构建$f(H)$的酉块编码。它利用了输入态和可观测量的结构，以及许多应用只需要可观测量的估计而不是合成完整的酉算符的事实。
我们提出了三种算法，它们利用初始态和可观测量的结构来减少量子电路深度。首先，我们开发了一种状态感知QSVT算法，当与$H$和$|ψangle$相关的Krylov子空间是低维的或允许精确的低维近似时，该算法能以低电路深度制备目标态。其次，我们引入了一种可观测感知影子QSVT算法，它结合了新的可观测感知Krylov子空间和历史状态，以进一步减少电路深度和门复杂度。最后，我们开发了经典影子QSVT，它在没有可观测量先验知识或无需显式制备与$f(H)|ψangle$成比例的目标态的情况下，从$H$、$f$和$|ψangle$构建一个经典表示。这种表示使得在量子计算之后指定的可观测量也能估计目标量。总的来说，这三种算法为在各种设置下减少基于QSVT的计算的电路深度提供了工具。
tldr: 影子量子奇异值变换（Shadow QSVT）通过利用输入态和可观测量结构，旨在减少标准QSVT所需的量子资源，尤其是在仅需可观测量估计而非完整酉算符合成的场景。论文提出了三种算法来降低量子电路深度。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于系统性地减少了量子奇异值变换（QSVT）所需的量子资源。通过将重点从合成完整的酉算符转移到仅估计可观测量，并利用问题固有的结构（如初始态和可观测量的特性），该方法为实现更浅层的量子电路提供了实用的途径。这对于当前噪声中尺度量子（NISQ）设备的应用尤为重要，因为它能有效降低计算成本和错误率。引入状态感知、可观测感知和经典影子三种不同的方法，展现了其在多种情境下提高QSVT效率的普适性和灵活性。
motivation: 标准量子奇异值变换（QSVT）通过构建目标函数$f(H)$的酉块编码，需要大量的量子资源。然而，许多应用仅需要可观测量估计，而非合成完整的酉算符。因此，本研究旨在提供一种系统性的方法来减少QSVT所需的量子资源。
method:
本文提出了三种利用初始态和可观测量结构来减少量子电路深度的算法：
1.  **状态感知QSVT算法：** 当与$H$和$|ψangle$相关的Krylov子空间是低维的或存在精确的低维近似时，该算法能以低电路深度制备目标态。
2.  **可观测感知影子QSVT算法：** 结合了新的可观测感知Krylov子空间和历史状态，以进一步减少电路深度和门复杂度。
3.  **经典影子QSVT：** 在没有可观测量先验知识或无需显式制备目标态的情况下，从$H$、$f$和$|ψangle$构建一个经典表示。该表示使得在量子计算之后指定的可观测量也能估计目标量。
results: 这三种算法为在各种设置下减少基于QSVT的计算的电路深度提供了工具，从而降低了量子资源需求。
conclusion: 本文提出的三种影子量子奇异值变换（Shadow QSVT）算法，即状态感知QSVT、可观测感知影子QSVT和经典影子QSVT，通过利用输入态和可观测量的结构，成功地减少了基于QSVT的量子计算的电路深度和资源需求。

title: Query-Limited RAM Programs and their Applications
authors: Jiahui Liu, Justin Raizes, Bhaskar Roberts, Omri Shmueli
abstract:
Quantum one-time programs (Broadbent, Gutoski and Stebila, CRYPTO 2013) or OTPs for short, enable a functionality to be encoded into a quantum token that can be evaluated on a single chosen input and then becomes unusable. While powerful, this primitive is inherently stateless and tied to a setting in which a quantum token needs to be issued and distributed for every single evaluation of a circuit. This raises a natural question: can the one-time computation paradigm be extended to richer, stateful forms of controlled access, and would such an extension offer inherent advantages beyond standard OTPs?
  We introduce $\textit{query-limited RAM programs}$ (QLPs), a RAM-generalization of QOTPs that supports structured, stateful computation under bounded or policy-driven access. QLPs allow controlled sequences of evaluations while preventing adversarial forking or rollback of computational state. This enables new applications beyond stateless one-time programs, including quantum tokens for Turing Machines whose size depends only on $\textit{code length}$ (and not runtime), transferable $k$-time or budget-limited programs, and low-communication mechanisms for delegating computation in settings such as Software-as-a-Service.
  To construct QLPs, we introduce $\textit{one-shot programs}$, unifying one-shot signatures (Amos, Georgiou, Kiayias and Zhandry, STOC 2020) with the single effective query paradigm (Gupte, Liu, Raizes, Roberts and Vaikuntanathan, STOC 2025). We prove that one-shot programs generically imply query-limited programs, demonstrating that the strengthened unclonability guarantees of one-shot signatures translate into enhanced functionality. Along the way, we clarify the relationship between signature-token primitives and quantum one-time programs via generic constructions, essentially showing that one-time signing programs imply one-time general computation.
zh_title: 受限查询RAM程序及其应用
translation:
量子一次性程序（Broadbent, Gutoski和Stebila，CRYPTO 2013，简称OTPs）使得某种功能可以被编码到一个量子令牌中，该令牌在单一选定输入上求值后即变得无法使用。尽管该密码学原语功能强大，但它本质上是无状态的，且局限于需要为电路的每次求值发布和分发量子令牌的场景。这引发了一个自然的问题：一次性计算范式能否扩展到更丰富、有状态的受控访问形式，并且这种扩展是否能提供超越标准OTP的固有优势？
我们引入了“查询受限RAM程序”（QLPs），它是QOTP向RAM的推广，支持在有界或策略驱动访问下的结构化、有状态计算。QLPs允许受控的求值序列，同时防止对抗性的计算状态分叉或回滚。这使得无状态一次性程序无法实现的新应用成为可能，包括大小仅取决于“代码长度”（而非运行时间）的图灵机量子令牌、可转让的$k$次或预算受限程序，以及在软件即服务（SaaS）等场景中用于委托计算的低通信机制。
为了构造QLPs，我们引入了“一次性程序”（one-shot programs），它将一次性签名（Amos, Georgiou, Kiayias和Zhandry, STOC 2020）与单有效查询范式（Gupte, Liu, Raizes, Roberts和Vaikuntanathan, STOC 2025）统一起来。我们证明了一次性程序可以泛化地推出查询受限程序，这表明一次性签名的增强不可克隆性保证可以转化为增强的功能性。在此过程中，我们通过通用构造阐明了签名令牌原语与量子一次性程序之间的关系，本质上展示了一次性签名程序意味着一次性通用计算。
tldr: 本文提出了查询受限RAM程序（QLP）和一次性程序，将无状态的量子一次性计算扩展为有状态、受控访问的强大范式。
ai_comments: 该论文将无状态的量子一次性程序推广到了支持有状态、受控访问的查询受限RAM程序（QLP），并通过引入“一次性程序”（one-shot programs）建立了统一的框架，具有很强的理论创新性和广泛的应用前景。
motivation: 传统的量子一次性程序（OTP）本质上是无状态的，且每次评估都需要重新分发量子令牌，这引发了关于能否将一次性计算范式扩展到更丰富、有状态的受控访问形式并带来固有优势的研究动机。
method: 引入了查询受限RAM程序（QLP）以及统一一次性签名与单有效查询范式的“一次性程序”，并证明了一次性程序能够泛化推导出口令受限程序，同时阐明了签名令牌原语与量子一次性程序之间的泛化构造关系。
results: 证明了“一次性程序”可以泛化地推出查询受限程序，从而实现了诸如代码长度相关的图灵机量子令牌、可转让的$k$次或预算受限程序，以及低通信量的计算外包机制（如SaaS）。
conclusion: 通过引入查询受限RAM程序（QLP）和一次性程序，论文成功将量子一次性计算范式扩展到更丰富、有状态的受控访问场景，展现了强大的理论和应用价值。

title: A mixing time method for estimating the sample complexity of quantum state discrimination
authors: Juntai Zhou, Felix Leditzky
abstract: We develop a mixing time method for estimating the sample complexity of quantum state discrimination. We start with considering the minimum-error discrimination of geometrically uniform pure state ensembles, and prove that its sample complexity has a tight estimate given by a quantum homogeneous mixing time [George et al., 2026] and a quantum version of the generalized Dobrushin coefficient [Wolfer, 2020]. This quantum mixing time further reduces to a classical one when the generating group $G$ forms a Gelfand pair with the stabilizer subgroup $H$ of the generator state. In this case the generalized Dobrushin coefficient can be fully expressed by representation-theoretic quantities of the commutative Hecke algebra $\operatorname{End}_G(\mathbb C[G/H])$. In particular, this method reduces the sample complexity estimation of learning quantum coupon collector states [Arunachalam et al., 2020] and learning phase states to classical mixing time problems. We apply this framework to answer the open problems of learning degree-$d$ phase states over $\mathbb F_q$ in [Alrabiah et al., 2026] and generalized Boolean phase states over $\mathbb Z_q$ [Arunachalam et al., 2023]. The framework also applies to hypergraph state ensembles, giving estimates expressed fully in terms of hypergraph data and recovering estimates for graph state ensembles in [Montanaro and Shao, 2022]. Finally, we extend the discussion to arbitrary mixed state ensembles with uniform priors, prove a sandwiched bound for minimum-error discrimination sample complexity by a quantum weakly mixing time, and provide a tight estimate for the minimax discrimination sample complexity from [D'Ariano et al., 2005] by a Dobrushin-type coefficient. We also discuss the method of strengthened data processing inequality [Gao and Rouz{é}, 2022] and give an upper bound in terms of a strengthened data processing inequality constant.
zh_title: 一种估算量子态判别样本复杂度的混合时间方法
translation: 我们开发了一种混合时间方法来估算量子态判别的样本复杂度。我们首先考虑几何均匀纯态集合的最小误差判别，并证明其样本复杂度由量子齐次混合时间 [George et al., 2026] 和广义 Dobrushin 系数的量子版本 [Wolfer, 2020] 提供一个紧密估计。当生成群 G 与生成态的稳定子群 H 形成 Gelfand 对时，这种量子混合时间进一步简化为经典混合时间。在这种情况下，广义 Dobrushin 系数可以通过可交换 Hecke 代数 $\operatorname{End}_G(\mathbb C[G/H])$ 的表示论量完全表达。特别是，该方法将学习量子优惠券收集者态 [Arunachalam et al., 2020] 和学习相位态的样本复杂度估计问题简化为经典的混合时间问题。我们将此框架应用于回答 [Alrabiah et al., 2026] 中关于学习 $\mathbb F_q$ 上的 $d$ 度相位态和 [Arunachalam et al., 2023] 中关于广义布尔相位态的开放问题。该框架也适用于超图态集合，给出了完全以超图数据表示的估计，并恢复了 [Montanaro and Shao, 2022] 中关于图态集合的估计。最后，我们将讨论扩展到具有均匀先验的任意混合态集合，证明了最小误差判别样本复杂度的量子弱混合时间的夹逼界，并通过 Dobrushin 型系数提供了 [D'Ariano et al., 2005] 中最大最小判别样本复杂度的紧密估计。我们还讨论了加强数据处理不等式 [Gao and Rouz{é}, 2022] 的方法，并给出了基于加强数据处理不等式常数的上限。
tldr: 开发了一种基于混合时间的方法来估算量子态判别的样本复杂度，并将其应用于几何均匀纯态、混合态集合以及特定量子学习问题。
ai_comments: 该论文通过引入混合时间方法，为量子态判别的样本复杂度估算提供了一个统一且强大的框架。其创新点在于将复杂的量子问题与经典的混合时间理论联系起来，特别是在Gelfand对条件下，实现了量子到经典的简化。该方法不仅解决了多个量子学习领域的开放问题，还为不同类型的量子态集合（包括纯态、混合态、超图态）提供了具体的估算工具，显示出其理论深度和广泛的实用潜力。
motivation: 该研究旨在开发一种新的方法来估算量子态判别的样本复杂度，特别是对于几何均匀纯态和混合态集合，并解决一些开放的量子学习问题。
method: 该论文开发了一种基于混合时间的方法来估算量子态判别的样本复杂度。具体方法包括：考虑几何均匀纯态集合的最小误差判别，并证明其样本复杂度由量子齐次混合时间与广义 Dobrushin 系数的量子版本紧密估算。当生成群 G 与生成态的稳定子群 H 形成 Gelfand 对时，量子混合时间简化为经典混合时间，广义 Dobrushin 系数可通过可交换 Hecke 代数的表示论量表达。该方法将量子优惠券收集者态和相位态的学习问题简化为经典的混合时间问题，并应用于回答学习 $d$ 度相位态和广义布尔相位态的开放问题。此外，该框架还适用于超图态集合，并扩展到具有均匀先验的任意混合态集合，为最小误差判别样本复杂度提供量子弱混合时间的夹逼界，并通过 Dobrushin 型系数提供最大最小判别样本复杂度的紧密估计。论文还讨论了加强数据处理不等式方法。
results: 论文证明了几何均匀纯态集合的最小误差判别样本复杂度可以通过量子齐次混合时间与广义 Dobrushin 系数的量子版本进行紧密估算。在特定条件下（Gelfand 对），量子混合时间可简化为经典混合时间，并且广义 Dobrushin 系数可以通过可交换 Hecke 代数的表示论量完全表达。该方法成功地将学习量子优惠券收集者态和学习相位态的样本复杂度估计问题简化为经典的混合时间问题，并回答了多个关于相位态学习的开放问题。该框架为超图态集合提供了完全以超图数据表示的估计，并为具有均匀先验的任意混合态集合的最小误差判别样本复杂度提供了量子弱混合时间的夹逼界，通过 Dobrushin 型系数为最大最小判别样本复杂度提供了紧密估计。此外，还给出了基于加强数据处理不等式常数的上限。
conclusion: 该论文开发了一种通用的混合时间方法来估算量子态判别的样本复杂度，该方法适用于多种量子态集合，包括几何均匀纯态和任意混合态，并成功应用于解决多个量子学习领域的开放问题，显示出其广泛的适用性和有效性。

title: Submodularity of entropy under quantum convolution
authors: Milad M. Goodarzi
abstract: We develop a submodular framework for the von Neumann entropy of discrete quantum convolutions, providing a noncommutative counterpart to the direct side of entropic additive combinatorics. We first introduce globally weighted quantum convolutions, which form compatible families indexed by admissible subsets of a fixed collection of inputs. Our main theorem reveals a polymatroidal geometry underlying their entropy growth: relative to any fixed admissible input block, the entropy gains admit a normalized, monotone, submodular extension to all subsets of the remaining inputs. The theorem yields convolutional strong subadditivity, quantum Ruzsa triangle inequality, and quantum entropic Plünnecke--Ruzsa inequalities for arbitrary input states. For repeated inputs, it gives sharp comparisons of entropy growth across admissible scales; in particular, the quantum doubling constant controls all higher admissible convolution entropies with optimal exponents. Together, these results bring submodular methods from additive combinatorics into the quantum setting and provide a systematic route to broad families of convolutional entropy inequalities.
zh_title: 量子卷积下熵的次模性
translation: 我们为离散量子卷积的冯诺依曼熵开发了一个次模框架，为熵加性组合学的直接方面提供了一个非交换对应。我们首先引入全局加权量子卷积，它们形成了由固定输入集合的可允许子集索引的兼容族。我们的主定理揭示了其熵增长背后的复拟阵几何：相对于任何固定的可允许输入块，熵增益承认对剩余输入的所有子集进行归一化、单调、次模的扩展。该定理产生了卷积强次加性、量子Ruzsa三角不等式和任意输入状态的量子熵Plünnecke-Ruzsa不等式。对于重复输入，它提供了跨可允许尺度的熵增长的精确比较；特别是，量子倍增常数以最优指数控制所有更高阶的可允许卷积熵。总而言之，这些结果将加性组合学中的次模方法引入量子环境，并为广泛的卷积熵不等式提供了系统的途径。
tldr: 本文为离散量子卷积的冯诺依曼熵开发了一个次模框架，揭示了其熵增长的复拟阵几何特性，并推导出一系列量子熵不等式，将次模方法引入量子领域。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新之处在于成功地将经典的次模性概念及其在加性组合学中的应用推广到量子信息理论中的量子卷积熵。通过建立一个系统的次模框架，它不仅揭示了量子熵增长的深层几何结构（复拟阵几何），还统一并推导出了多个重要的量子熵不等式，如量子Ruzsa不等式。这为理解量子信息系统中的熵行为提供了一个强大的新工具，并可能在量子信息处理和量子通信中找到应用。
motivation: 开发一个针对离散量子卷积的冯诺依曼熵的次模框架，为熵加性组合学的直接方面提供非交换对应，并为广泛的卷积熵不等式提供系统途径。
method: 1. 开发了一个针对离散量子卷积的冯诺依曼熵的次模框架。2. 引入了全局加权量子卷积，它们形成了由固定输入集合的可允许子集索引的兼容族。3. 通过一个主定理揭示了其熵增长背后的复拟阵几何。
results: 1. 熵增益相对于任何固定的可允许输入块，对剩余输入的所有子集都承认一个归一化、单调、次模的扩展。2. 该定理产生了卷积强次加性、量子Ruzsa三角不等式和任意输入状态的量子熵Plünnecke-Ruzsa不等式。3. 对于重复输入，它提供了跨可允许尺度的熵增长的精确比较；特别是，量子倍增常数以最优指数控制所有更高阶的可允许卷积熵。
conclusion: 本研究将加性组合学中的次模方法引入量子环境，并为广泛的卷积熵不等式提供了系统的途径。

title: Improved quantum volume estimation with transducers and amortized quantum walks
authors: Arjan Cornelissen, Simon Apers, Sander Gribling
abstract: The volume estimation problem is a classic task in computational geometry. The development of randomized algorithms for this problem spurred the development of many influential algorithmic techniques related to Markov Chain Monte Carlo and simulated annealing, and the problem connects to several important geometrical results, like the recently-resolved KLS conjecture. In this work, we quantize the state-of-the-art $\widetilde{O}(d^{3.5}+d^3/\varepsilon^2)$-query randomized algorithm developed by Cousins and Vempala, and obtain a $\widetilde{O}(d^{3.5} + d^{1.75}/\varepsilon)$-query quantum algorithm, improving over the $\widetilde{O}(d^{3.5} + d^{2.25}/\varepsilon)$ state-of-the-art bound. Our key technical contribution is a framework for amortizing the cost of a quantum walk. The framework is based on the recent transducer toolkit introduced by Belovs, Jeffery and Yolcu. It is this amortized quantum walk framework that allows us to exploit the amortized analysis of the ball walk by Cousins and Vempala, thus overcoming the key barrier that previously barred its quantum implementation.
zh_title: 利用Transducer与摊销量子行走改进量子体积估计
translation: 体积估计问题是计算几何中的一个经典任务。该问题随机算法的发展推动了许多与马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛和模拟退火相关的影响深远的算法技术的发展，并且该问题与几个重要的几何结果相联系，例如最近解决的KLS猜想。在这项工作中，我们将会对Cousins和Vempala开发的最新$\widetilde{O}(d^{3.5}+d^3/\varepsilon^2)$查询随机算法进行量子化，并获得一个$\widetilde{O}(d^{3.5} + d^{1.75}/\varepsilon)$查询的量子算法，从而改进了$\widetilde{O}(d^{3.5} + d^{2.25}/\varepsilon)$的最新界限。我们关键的技术贡献是一个用于摊销量子行走成本的框架。该框架基于Belovs、Jeffery和Yolcu引入的最新transducer工具包。正是这个摊销量子行走框架使我们能够利用Cousins和Vempala对ball walk的摊销分析，从而克服了先前阻碍其量子实现的关键障碍。
tldr: 论文提出了一种利用transducer和摊销量子行走的新框架，改善了高维量子体积估计的查询复杂度。
ai_comments: 该论文在计算几何领域的量子算法设计上取得了重要突破，通过引入基于transducer的量子行走摊销（amortized quantum walk）框架，成功将高维体积估计的查询复杂度边界推到了新的高度。创新点在于成功将经典算法中的摊销分析映射并应用到量子设置中。
motivation: 为了突破先前无法在量子计算中实现Cousins和Vempala经典ball walk算法摊销分析的障碍，进一步改进高维空间中体积估计的量子查询复杂度。
method: 将Cousins和Vempala的最先进的随机算法进行量子化，并引入基于Belovs、Jeffery和Yolcu的transducer工具包的量子行走摊销框架，从而成功实现经典ball walk的摊销分析。
results: 提出了一种复杂度为$\widetilde{O}(d^{3.5} + d^{1.75}/\varepsilon)$的量子体积估计算法，改进了此前$\widetilde{O}(d^{3.5} + d^{2.25}/\varepsilon)$的最先进界限。
conclusion: 本研究通过结合transducer和摊销量子行走技术，成功改进了量子体积估计算法，显著降低了查询复杂度，解决了将经典ball walk算法进行量子化的核心障碍。

title: Quantum Algorithms for Minimum Generating Set
authors: Bireswar Das, Udit Kumar, Kavita Samant, Dhara Thakkar
abstract: In this paper, we present a polynomial-time quantum algorithm for computing a minimum-sized generating set of solvable black-box groups. Next, we consider the class $Γ_d$ of black-box groups, where every non-abelian composition factor is isomorphic to a subgroup of the symmetric group $S_d$ for a fixed $d$. We design polynomial-time quantum algorithms to compute the direct product decomposition of abelian factor groups and solve the constructive membership problem for factor groups of groups from $Γ_d$. With the help of these algorithms, we design a quantum algorithm for computing a chief series of black-box groups from $Γ_d$. Using the chief series, we construct a polynomial-time quantum algorithm for computing minimum generating sets of black-box groups from $Γ_d$. Finally, we show that the minimum generating set problem for general black-box groups is in $\textrm{NP} \cap \textrm{coAM}$.
translation: 在本文中，我们提出了一个多项式时间量子算法，用于计算可解黑盒群的最小生成集。接下来，我们考虑黑盒群的 $Γ_d$ 类，其中每个非阿贝尔组成因子都同构于固定 $d$ 的对称群 $S_d$ 的一个子群。我们设计了多项式时间量子算法来计算阿贝尔因子群的直积分解，并解决了 $Γ_d$ 类群的因子群的构造性成员问题。借助这些算法，我们设计了一个计算 $Γ_d$ 类黑盒群主序列的量子算法。利用主序列，我们构建了一个多项式时间量子算法，用于计算 $Γ_d$ 类黑盒群的最小生成集。最后，我们证明了通用黑盒群的最小生成集问题属于 $\textrm{NP} \cap \textrm{coAM}$ 复杂度类。
tldr: 本文提出了针对可解黑盒群和特定类黑盒群 ($Γ_d$) 的最小生成集的量子算法，并确定了通用黑盒群最小生成集问题的复杂度。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于利用量子算法解决了群论中的核心问题——最小生成集的计算，特别是针对特定限制性黑盒群类别的有效算法设计。它不仅提供了具体的量子计算方法，还对通用问题的复杂度进行了界定，对量子计算在代数结构分析中的应用具有重要意义。
motivation: 本文旨在为特定类型的黑盒群计算最小生成集，并探讨通用黑盒群最小生成集问题的计算复杂度。
method: 本文设计了多项式时间量子算法，用于：1. 计算可解黑盒群的最小生成集。2. 计算 $Γ_d$ 类黑盒群的阿贝尔因子群的直积分解和解决构造性成员问题。3. 计算 $Γ_d$ 类黑盒群的主序列。4. 利用主序列计算 $Γ_d$ 类黑盒群的最小生成集。
results: 本文提出了计算可解黑盒群最小生成集的多项式时间量子算法。为 $Γ_d$ 类黑盒群设计了计算阿贝尔因子群直积分解、解决构造性成员问题以及计算主序列的量子算法，并在此基础上构建了计算其最小生成集的多项式时间量子算法。此外，还证明了通用黑盒群的最小生成集问题属于 $\textrm{NP} \cap \textrm{coAM}$ 复杂度类。
conclusion: 本文为特定类型的黑盒群提供了多项式时间量子算法来计算其最小生成集，并确定了通用黑盒群的最小生成集问题属于 $\textrm{NP} \cap \textrm{coAM}$ 复杂度类。

title: A physical and universal model of bosonic computations with Solovay-Kitaev theorem
authors: Dorian Rudolph, Arsalan Motamedi, Dhruva Sambrani, Hamid Reza Naeij, Ulysse Chabaud, Sevag Gharibian, Saeed Mehraban
abstract:
Bosonic quantum systems are among the leading architectures for quantum information processing, offering continuous-variable degrees of freedom with strong error-correction capabilities. However, standard bosonic quantum computation models such as the Lloyd-Braunstein [Lloyd and Braunstein, 1999] and hybrid oscillator-qubit models [Brenner, Dias, and Koenig, 2025; Liu et al., 2026] permit dramatic energy growth, leading to unphysical computational power and the breakdown of fundamental algorithmic tools such as universal and efficient compilation [Brenner et al., 2026; Rudolph et al., 2025]. To address this, we introduce a new model of bosonic quantum computation, Bosonic Energy-Preserving Quantum Computation (BEQC), in which energy is treated as a computational resource. Namely, energy is supplied solely through input coherent states, and all gates are generated by energy-preserving Hamiltonians. Thus, by construction, dramatic energy growth is impossible, making the model physically grounded.
  We next show that BEQC is a computationally robust and universal model in many respects, including: (1. Computational power) BEQC efficiently simulates all polynomial-energy computations in existing models, and exactly recovers BQP in the polynomial energy setting. It further admits several complexity-theoretic upper bounds when varying the energy, precision, and space parameters of the model. (2. Universal gate sets and state synthesis) BEQC has natural universal gate sets based on linear optics and Kerr interactions. In particular, we obtain a Solovay-Kitaev theorem which circumvents previous no-go results. We give various applications, including (a) a protocol for engineering GKP states with rigorous preparation guarantees, (b) Fock state preparation to exponential precision, and (c) native Fock space simulation of any qubit-based unitary.
zh_title: 基于索洛维-基塔耶夫定理的玻色子计算物理与通用模型
translation:
玻色子量子系统是量子信息处理的主要架构之一，提供了具有强大纠错能力的连续变量自由度。然而，标准的玻色子量子计算模型（如Lloyd-Braunstein模型和混合振子-量子比特模型）允许剧烈的能量增长，导致非物理的计算能力以及通用且高效编译等基本算法工具的失效。为了解决这一问题，我们引入了一种新的玻色子量子计算模型——玻色子能量守恒量子计算（BEQC），在该模型中，能量被视为一种计算资源。也就是说，能量仅通过输入相干态提供，且所有门均由能量守恒哈密顿量生成。因此，从构造上讲，剧烈的能量增长是不可能的，从而使该模型具有物理基础。
我们进一步证明了BEQC在许多方面是一个计算上稳健且通用的模型，包括：（1. 计算能力）BEQC能高效模拟现有模型中的所有多项式能量计算，并在多项式能量设置下精确恢复BQP。在改变模型的能量、精度和空间参数时，它还支持几个复杂性理论的上界。（2. 通用门集与状态综合）BEQC拥有基于线性光学和克尔相互作用的自然通用门集。特别是，我们获得了绕过以往无果结果的索洛维-基塔耶夫定理。我们给出了各种应用，包括（a）具有严格制备保证的GKP态工程协议，（b）达到指数精度的福克态制备，以及（c）任意基于量子比特的幺正算符的原生福克空间模拟。
tldr: 本文提出了一种物理上合理且通用的玻色子量子计算模型（BEQC），限制了能量的非物理增长，并证明了其计算通用性及在状态制备中的应用。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种物理上合理且通用的玻色子量子计算模型（BEQC），通过将能量视为计算资源并限制能量守恒，解决了传统模型中能量无限增长的不物理问题，并在量子计算复杂性理论和门集综合（特别是索洛维-基塔耶夫定理的应用）方面取得了重要突破。
motivation: 标准的玻色子量子计算模型允许剧烈的能量增长，导致计算能力不符合物理实际，且破坏了通用且高效编译等基本算法工具。为了解决这一问题，需要建立一个物理上合理且通用的玻色子计算模型。
method: 引入了玻色子能量守恒量子计算（BEQC）模型，其中能量仅通过输入相干态提供，所有门由能量守恒哈密顿量生成；并应用线性光学、克尔相互作用以及索洛维-基塔耶夫定理进行通用门集和状态综合分析。
results: BEQC能高效模拟现有模型中的所有多项式能量计算，在多项式能量设置下精确恢复BQP；获得了基于线性光学和克尔相互作用的通用门集，推导出了适用于BEQC的索洛维-基塔耶夫定理，并应用于GKP态工程、高精度福克态制备及量子比特幺正模拟。
conclusion: BEQC模型成功解决了传统玻色子计算模型中能量无限增长的物理不合理性，证明了其在物理上的合理性及计算上的通用性与鲁棒性。

title: Quantum oblique eigenprojection
authors: Alexander M. Dalzell, Yuan Su
abstract: Every square matrix decomposes its underlying Hilbert space into generalized, nonorthogonal eigensubspaces. We show that a quantum computer can perform such an oblique eigenprojection $Π$ given block encoding access to the input matrix. Our approach has a query complexity nearly linear in the inverse gap and a normalization factor close to $\lVertΠ\rVert$ under a spectral-set condition on the input. This covers common assumptions on the numerical range or diagonalizability and matches known results for orthogonal eigenprojections. We achieve this with a two-sided block preconditioning that uses a discrete Fourier transform of the matrix resolvent. We describe applications to: (i) preparing eigenstates of matrices with complex eigenvalues, extending the quantum eigenvalue transformation algorithm of Low and Su beyond real spectra; (ii) solving continuous-time algebraic Riccati equations, cubically speeding up a prior solver of Rodenas-Ruiz, Zhao, and Lee; and (iii) solving ordinary Sylvester equations, quadratically improving a direct augmented method of Wang and Liu. Our result suggests a promising route to applying nonanalytic matrix functions on quantum computers.
translation: 每个方阵都将其基础希尔伯特空间分解为广义的、非正交的本征子空间。我们展示了量子计算机可以在给定输入矩阵的块编码访问权限的情况下执行这种斜本征投影 Π。我们的方法在输入满足谱集条件时，查询复杂度接近逆间隙的线性，归一化因子接近 ||Π||。这涵盖了数值范围或可对角化性的常见假设，并与正交本征投影的已知结果相匹配。我们通过使用矩阵预解式的离散傅里叶变换的双边块预处理实现了这一点。我们描述了以下应用：(i) 制备具有复数特征值的矩阵的本征态，将Low和Su的量子特征值变换算法扩展到实数谱之外；(ii) 求解连续时间代数Riccati方程，将Rodenas-Ruiz、Zhao和Lee的先前求解器速度提高三次方；以及(iii) 求解普通Sylvester方程，将Wang和Liu的直接增广方法速度提高二次方。我们的结果表明，在量子计算机上应用非解析矩阵函数是一条有前景的途径。
tldr: 量子计算机可以对输入矩阵执行斜本征投影，具有接近线性的查询复杂度，并应用于制备本征态、求解Riccati方程和Sylvester方程。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过在量子计算机上实现斜本征投影，扩展了量子算法处理非解析矩阵函数的能力，具有重要的创新性。它不仅推广了现有的量子特征值变换算法，还为解决复杂的代数方程提供了显著的速度提升，为量子计算在更广泛的科学和工程问题中的应用开辟了新路径。
motivation: 解决方阵将其希尔伯特空间分解为广义的、非正交本征子空间的问题，并使量子计算机能够执行这种斜本征投影。
method: 采用双边块预处理，该预处理利用矩阵预解式的离散傅里叶变换，并假设对输入矩阵具有块编码访问权限。
results: 该方法在输入满足谱集条件时，查询复杂度接近逆间隙的线性，归一化因子接近||Π||。它覆盖了数值范围或可对角化性的常见假设，并与正交本征投影的已知结果相匹配。具体应用包括：(i) 制备具有复数特征值的矩阵的本征态，扩展了Low和Su的量子特征值变换算法；(ii) 求解连续时间代数Riccati方程，将Rodenas-Ruiz、Zhao和Lee的先前求解器速度提高三次方；(iii) 求解普通Sylvester方程，将Wang和Liu的直接增广方法速度提高二次方。
conclusion: 结果表明，在量子计算机上应用非解析矩阵函数是一条有前景的途径。

title: Quantum List Recovery and Decoding: Achievability and Limitations
authors: Fernando Granha Jeronimo, Xiaojuan Ma
abstract:
Quantum list recovery (QLR) and quantum list decoding (QLD) seek short lists of logically distinct Pauli corrections consistent with a syndrome and prescribed error constraints. For CSS codes, two issues arise: treating the \(X\)- and \(Z\)-sectors separately can multiply their output list sizes, while distinct classical candidates can collapse after stabilizer quotienting.
  We study combinatorial upper and lower bounds for balanced folded quantum Reed--Solomon (FQRS) codes and balanced random CSS codes, both studied by Bergamaschi, Golowich, and Gunn (STOC 24). Let \(R\in(0,1)\) be the quantum rate and \(R_1=(1+R)/2\) the common component rate. As the radius \(ρ=(1-R)/2-γ\) approaches the quantum Singleton bound, we have, deterministically for FQRS codes and w.h.p. for balanced random CSS codes, \[
  L^\star_{\rm QLR}
  =
  \ell^{Θ(R_1/γ)},
  \qquad
  L^\star_{\rm QLD}
  =
  Θ\!\left(\frac{1-R}γ\right)
  \qquad (γ\downarrow0). \] The asymptotically exact QLD radius tradeoff is \[
  ρ_L^\star
  =
  \frac{L}{L+1}\frac{1-R}{2}. \] These conclusions extend to the average-radius setting.
  For achievability, building on the work of Brakensiek, Chen, Dhar, and Zhang (STOC 2026), we establish a pairing lemma for joint \(X/Z\) candidate lists that preserves the one-sector coefficient and avoids a product loss in list size. For the QLD converse, we prove a quantum generalized Singleton bound based on the classical projection-and-patching argument with stabilizer distinctness. For the QLR lower bounds, we adapt the folded Reed--Solomon construction of Chen and Zhang (STOC 2025) so that the candidates remain stabilizer distinct. For random CSS codes, we show classical bad lists survive the stabilizer quotient with high probability.
zh_title: 量子列表恢复与译码：可达性与局限性
translation:
量子列表恢复（QLR）和量子列表译码（QLD）旨在寻找与综合征和规定的错误约束相一致的逻辑上不同的泡利修正短列表。对于CSS codes，会出现两个问题：单独处理\(X\)-和\(Z\)-扇区会使它们的输出列表大小相乘，而不同的经典候选者在稳定子商空间化后会发生塌缩。
我们研究了由Bergamaschi、Golowich和Gunn（STOC 24）研究的平衡折叠量子里德-索罗门（FQRS）码和平衡随机CSS码的组合上下界。设\(R\in(0,1)\)为量子速率，\(R_1=(1+R)/2\)为公共分量速率。当半径\(ρ=(1-R)/2-γ\)接近量子单格顿界时，对于FQRS码（确定性地）和平衡随机CSS码（以高概率），我们有\(L^\star_{\rm QLR} = \ell^{Θ(R_1/γ)}\)，\(L^\star_{\rm QLD} = Θ\!\left(\frac{1-R}γ\right)\)（当\(γ\downarrow0\)时）。渐近精确的QLD半径权衡为\(ρ_L^\star = \frac{L}{L+1}\frac{1-R}{2}\)。这些结论延伸到了平均半径设置。
在可达性方面，基于Brakensiek、Chen、Dhar和Zhang（STOC 2026）的工作，我们为联合\(X/Z\)候选列表建立了一个配对引理，该引理保留了单扇区系数并避免了列表大小的乘积损失。对于QLD逆定理，我们基于带有稳定子可区分性的经典投影与修补论证，证明了一个量子广义单格顿界。对于QLR下界，我们调整了Chen和Zhang（STOC 2025）的折叠里德-索罗门构造，使候选者保持稳定子可区分性。对于随机CSS码，我们证明了经典坏列表以高概率在稳定子商空间中存活。
keywords: 折叠量子里德-索罗门码
tldr: 论文研究了量子列表恢复与译码的可行性与局限性，建立了平衡折叠量子里德-索罗门码和随机CSS码的精确渐近界。
ai_comments: 该论文深入研究了量子纠错码中的量子列表恢复（QLR）和量子列表译码（QLD），特别是针对平衡折叠量子里德-索罗门（FQRS）码和平衡随机CSS码，建立了清晰的上下界和渐近半径权衡，对量子编码理论具有重要推动作用。
motivation: 为了解决CSS码在量子列表恢复和译码中遇到的两个主要问题：将X和Z扇区单独处理会导致输出列表大小呈乘积级增长，以及不同的经典候选者在稳定子商空间化后会发生塌缩，从而研究平衡折叠量子里德-索罗门码和平衡随机CSS码的组合上下界。
method: 通过建立联合X/Z候选列表的配对引理来实现可达性；通过带有稳定子区分性的经典投影与修补参数证明量子广义单格顿界（逆定理）；通过调整折叠里德-索罗门构造及证明经典坏列表在稳定子商空间中高概率存活来得出下界。
results: 得到了FQRS码和平衡随机CSS码在接近量子单格顿界时的QLR和QLD的确切渐近列表大小及渐近精确的QLD半径权衡关系。
conclusion: 论文成功建立了量子列表恢复和译码的组合上界与下界，阐明了其渐近半径权衡，并通过创新性技术克服了经典扇区独立处理带来的乘积损失问题。

title: Superlinear Quantum Query Lower Bounds for Subgraph Detection
authors: Amin Shiraz Gilani, Xingyu Zhou
abstract:
Subgraph detection asks whether an $n$-vertex graph, accessed through queries to its adjacency matrix, contains a copy of a fixed graph $H$. We prove the first unconditional superlinear lower bounds on the bounded-error quantum query complexity of this problem, answering a longstanding open question. A copy of $H$ is a certificate of constant size, so the adversary method with nonnegative weights cannot prove superlinear lower bounds.
  For every fixed $r\ge 4$, detecting the clique $K_r$ requires $n^{λ_r-o(1)}$ queries, where $λ_4=19/18$, the exponents $λ_r$ increase strictly with $r$, and $λ_r\ge 2-4\sqrt{2/r}+O(1/r)$. More generally, we prove superlinear lower bounds for detecting every fixed connected graph $H$ with chromatic number $c\ge 4$. These bounds approach quadratic as $c$ grows: for sufficiently large $c$, detection requires $n^{2-O(\sqrt{\log\log c/c})-o(1)}$ queries. Chromatic number alone does not characterize the quantum query complexity of subgraph detection: we show that detecting the complete bipartite graph $K_{r,r}$ requires $n^{β_r-o(1)}$ queries, where $β_{10}=181/180$ and $β_r\ge 2-O(1/\sqrt{r})$.
  Our main technical result is a lower bound for finding an all-ones certificate from a known family when the input bits are sampled independently. Its proof combines Zhandry's compressed oracle (CRYPTO 2019) with conditioning on a randomly planted certificate, adapting an argument of Belovs (FOCS 2026). Our hard instances are built from graphs containing many copies of the desired subgraph with limited overlap. For cliques, we use a construction of Gowers and Janzer (CPC 2021); for complete bipartite graphs, we use a random construction.
zh_title: 子图检测问题的超线性量子查询下界
translation:
子图检测询问一个通过其邻接矩阵访问的 $n$ 顶点图是否包含固定图 $H$ 的副本。我们证明了该问题在有界错误量子查询复杂度下的首个无条件超线性下界，解答了一个长期存在的公开问题。由于 $H$ 的副本是一个常数大小的证书，带有非负权重的对抗方法无法证明超线性下界。
对于每个固定的 $r\ge 4$，检测团 $K_r$ 需要 $n^{\lambda_r-o(1)}$ 次查询，其中 $\lambda_4=19/18$，指数 $\lambda_r$ 随 $r$ 严格递增，且 $\lambda_r\ge 2-4\sqrt{2/r}+O(1/r)$。更一般地，我们证明了检测每个色数 $c\ge 4$ 的固定连通图 $H$ 的超线性下界。随着 $c$ 的增长，这些下界趋近于二次方：对于足够大的 $c$，检测需要 $n^{2-O(\sqrt{\log\log c/c})-o(1)}$ 次查询。仅凭色数并不能表征子图检测的量子查询复杂度：我们证明检测完全二分图 $K_{r,r}$ 需要 $n^{\beta_r-o(1)}$ 次查询，其中 $\beta_{10}=181/180$，且 $\beta_r\ge 2-O(1/\sqrt{r})$。
我们的主要技术结果是当输入比特被独立采样时，从已知族中寻找全1证书的下界。其证明将 Zhandry 的压缩oracle（CRYPTO 2019）与对随机植入证书的条件概率相结合，改编自 Belovs（FOCS 2026）的论证。我们的困难实例由包含许多具有有限重叠的目标子图副本的图构建而成。对于团，我们使用 Gowers 和 Janzer（CPC 2021）的构造；对于完全二分图，我们使用随机构造。
tldr: 论文首次证明了子图检测问题的超线性量子查询下界，解决了长期以来的公开问题。
ai_comments: 该论文首次证明了子图检测问题的无条件超线性量子查询下界，解决了该领域长期以来的公开问题，技术上巧妙结合了Zhandry的压缩预言机和条件概率方法。
motivation: 解决关于子图检测问题有界错误量子查询复杂度的长期公开问题，超越非负权重对抗方法无法证明超线性下界的局限。
method: 通过结合Zhandry的压缩预言机（compressed oracle）与对随机植入证书的条件概率方法，证明了在输入位独立采样时寻找已知族中全1证书的下界，并利用具有有限重叠的多副本图结构构建困难实例。
results: 证明了对于任意固定 $r\ge 4$ 的团 $K_r$、色数 $c\ge 4$ 的连通图以及完全二分图 $K_{r,r}$，检测它们需要超线性的量子查询次数，并且随着 $c$ 或 $r$ 的增长，下界渐近逼近平方。
conclusion: 论文建立了子图检测在有界错误量子查询模型下的首个超线性下界，极大推进了图性质测试和量子复杂性理论的发展。

title: Refined sample complexities from the tomographic rate function
authors: Arick Grootveld, Alexander Maloney, Jason Pollack, Peixue Wu
abstract: Protocols for quantum state tomography can be characterized either by their sample complexity or by the tomographic rate function that governs the large deviation behaviour of error estimates. We establish a framework for the analysis of covariant protocols which allows us to compare these measures. First, we derive the rate functions for several protocols, including random purification-based protocols and the sample-optimal protocol of Haah et al. These rate functions are expressed in terms of a new family of divergences which includes the reverse sandwiched Rényi divergence and Keyl's annealed quantum relative entropy as special cases. We show that these rate functions obey a strict ordering, even though the sample complexity of each protocol is order optimal. We consider a different version of sample complexity based on Wasserstein distance rather than trace distance, and show that the ordering of the rate functions implies analogous strict inequalities for the Wasserstein-type sample complexity. Thus the tomographic rate function is a more fine-grained indicator of the performance of a tomography protocol than the usual sample complexity.
zh_title: 基于层析率函数的精确样本复杂度
translation: 量子态层析协议可以通过其样本复杂度或控制误差估计大偏差行为的层析率函数来表征。我们建立了一个用于分析协变协议的框架，从而能够比较这些度量。首先，我们推导了几种协议的率函数，包括基于随机纯化的协议以及Haah等人的样本最优协议。这些率函数用一个新的散度族来表示，其中包括反向夹逼Rényi散度和Keyl的退火量子相对熵作为特例。我们表明，即使每个协议的样本复杂度都是阶最优的，这些率函数也服从严格的排序。我们考虑了基于Wasserstein距离而非迹距离的不同版本的样本复杂度，并证明率函数的排序意味着Wasserstein型样本复杂度的类似严格不等式。因此，与通常的样本复杂度相比，层析率函数是量子态层析协议性能更细粒度的指标。
tldr: 量子态层析率函数比传统样本复杂度提供了更精细的协议性能指标。
ai_comments: 该论文通过引入层析率函数（tomographic rate function）对量子态层析协议进行了更精细的性能分析，超越了传统样本复杂度的粗粒度比较，具有重要的理论创新意义。
motivation: 传统的样本复杂度无法完全刻画量子态层析协议的细粒度性能差异，因此需要通过大偏差行为中的层析率函数来进行更深入的比较。
method: 建立了一个用于分析协变协议的统一框架，导出了多种协议的率函数，并利用新型散度族以及Wasserstein距离进行严格的排序和比较。
results: 导出了多种层析协议的率函数，发现这些率函数表现出严格的排序，并进一步推导出了基于Wasserstein距离的样本复杂度的严格不等式。
conclusion: 层析率函数比传统的样本复杂度更能精细地区分不同量子态层析协议的性能，并揭示了样本复杂度未曾展现的严格排序。

title: Computational Bounds for $f$-Routing
authors: Oren Renard, Nicholas Spooner
abstract:
The $f$-routing protocol is a leading candidate for quantum position verification (Kent, Munro, and Spiller, 2011), but security guarantees for explicit functions remain limited. We prove unconditional resource lower bounds for uniform attackers; our new techniques bypass communication-complexity bounds central to previous works, which are inherently at most linear in the input length.
  We show that, for input length $n$ and sufficiently small constant $ε>0$, a uniformly generated strategy using $q$ qubits and having description length $\mathrm{poly}(q)$, with success probability at least $1-ε$ on every input, implies the following computational bounds on $f$:
  1. If the strategies are arbitrary quantum channels, then $f\in\mathrm{QSZK}(\mathrm{poly}(nq))$, where $\mathrm{QSZK}(T)$ is the class of languages having quantum statistical zero knowledge proofs in which the verifier runs in time $T$ (and the simulator in time $\mathrm{poly}(T)$).
  2. If the strategies are explicit Pauli-sparse unitaries on $q$ qubits that have at most $s$ nonzero Pauli coefficients, then $f\in\mathrm{DTIME}(\mathrm{poly}(nqs))$.
  3. If the strategies are Clifford+T circuits using at most $t$ magic gates, then $f\in\mathrm{DTIME}(\mathrm{poly}(nq2^t))$.
  Time and space hierarchies then yield explicit functions secure against polynomial and even quasipolynomial qubits $q$ under our computational restrictions. These bounds exceed the $q\le\log n$ bound of Bluhm, Christandl, and Speelman (2022) for inner product function $f=\mathrm{IP}$, at the cost of restricting adversarial computation and increasing honest evaluation complexity.
translation:
$f$-routing 协议是量子位置验证（Kent, Munro 和 Spiller，2011）的主要候选方案，但显式函数的安全保证仍然有限。我们证明了统一攻击者的无条件资源下界；我们的新技术绕过了以往工作中核心的通信复杂度下界，这些下界在输入长度上本质上最多是线性的。
我们证明，对于输入长度为 $n$ 且具有足够小的常数 $\varepsilon > 0$，使用 $q$ 个量子比特且描述长度为 $\mathrm{poly}(q)$、在每个输入上成功概率至少为 $1-\varepsilon$ 的均匀生成策略，意味着对 $f$ 的以下计算界限：
1. 如果策略是任意量子通道，则 $f \in \mathrm{QSZK}(\mathrm{poly}(nq))$，其中 $\mathrm{QSZK}(T)$ 是具有量子统计零知识证明的语言类，其中验证者运行时间为 $T$（模拟器运行时间为 $\mathrm{poly}(T)$）。
2. 如果策略是 $q$ 量子比特上的显式 Pauli 稀疏幺正算符，且具有至多 $s$ 个非零 Pauli 系数，则 $f \in \mathrm{DTIME}(\mathrm{poly}(nqs))$。
3. 如果策略是使用至多 $t$ 个 magic 门的 Clifford+T 电路，则 $f \in \mathrm{DTIME}(\mathrm{poly}(nq2^t))$。
随后，时间和空间层次定理在我们的计算限制下，对多项式甚至拟多项式量子比特 $q$ 给出了抗性显式函数。这些界限超越了 Bluhm, Christandl 和 Speelman (2022) 对内积函数 $f=\mathrm{IP}$ 的 $q \le \log n$ 的界限，代价是限制了对抗性计算并增加了诚实评估的复杂度。
tldr: 该论文为量子位置验证中的 $f$-routing 协议建立了底层函数的无条件计算下界，突破了以往通信复杂度的限制，证明了特定攻击策略下函数所属的复杂性类。
ai_comments: 该论文通过引入新的分析技术，成功突破了以往通信复杂度下界的限制，建立了关于 $f$-routing 协议中底层函数 $f$ 的无条件计算复杂性下界。这些结果对于量子位置验证的安全性分析具有重要意义。
motivation: $f$-routing 协议是量子位置验证的重要候选方案，但目前针对显式函数的安全保证仍然非常有限，缺乏对其底层的计算下界和通用安全性的深入理解。
method: 通过证明统一攻击者的无条件资源下界，绕过了以往研究中依赖于输入长度最多呈线性的通信复杂度下界，从而建立了关于 $f$ 的计算复杂性类限制。
results: 证明了在成功概率至少为 $1-\varepsilon$ 的前提下，对于不同类型的攻击策略（任意量子通道、显式 Pauli 稀疏幺正算符、Clifford+T 电路），函数 $f$ 分别落入相应的复杂性类（QSZK 或 DTIME）中。
conclusion: 论文证明了在特定策略下 $f$-routing 协议对函数 $f$ 的计算下界，并通过时间与空间层次定理得出了在特定计算限制下对多项式甚至拟多项式量子比特安全的显式函数。

title: Need for Coherent Access in Constructing Quantum Cryptography
authors: Minki Hhan, Changhun Oh, Vaughn Sohn
abstract:
We construct quantum oracles relative to which quantum-secure one-way functions (OWFs) exist but pseudorandom states (PRSs) with superlogarithmic output length do not. At first glance, this appears to contradict the known black-box constructions of PRS generators from quantum-secure OWFs. The distinction lies in the access model to the oracles; our oracle separation uses \emph{classical-accessible} random oracles that can be accessed only classically even by quantum algorithms. In fact, our impossibility of PRSs applies to \emph{any} classically accessible classical oracle in place of the random oracle, while keeping the other oracle component unchanged, showing the need for coherent access in constructing PRSs.
  We further show that logarithmic output length pseudorandom function-like states (PRFSs) exist relative to our oracles, giving an oracle separation between classically accessible logarithmic length PRFSs and superlogarithmic length PRSs. This shows that fully black-box PRS length extension from logarithmic to superlogarithmic output length must use coherent access to the underlying short PRS.
zh_title: 构建量子密码学中相干访问的需求
translation:
我们构造了相对的量子预言机，在这些预言机下量子安全的一路函数（OWF）存在，但输出长度为超对数的伪随机态（PRS）不存在。初看之下，这与已知的从量子安全OWF通过黑盒构造PRS生成器的结论相矛盾。其区别在于对预言机的访问模型；我们的预言机分离使用了“经典可访问”的随机预言机，即使是量子算法也只能对其进行经典访问。事实上，我们关于PRS的不可能性结论适用于代替随机预言机的“任何”经典可访问经典预言机（同时保持其他预言机组件不变），这表明在构造PRS时需要相干访问。
我们进一步证明了，相对我们的预言机，输出长度为对数的伪随机函数态（PRFSs）是存在的，从而给出了经典可访问的对数长度PRFS与超对数长度PRS之间的预言机分离。这表明，将PRS输出长度从对数扩展到超对数的完全黑盒方法必须使用对底层短PRS的相干访问。
tldr: 论文证明了从量子安全的一路函数构建伪随机态（PRS）或进行PRS长度扩展时，必须使用相干访问（coherent access），经典可访问预言机是不够的。
ai_comments: 该论文通过构造量子预言机，在理论上证明了在经典可访问预言机下量子安全的一路函数（OWF）可以存在，但超对数输出长度的伪随机态（PRS）不存在。这一发现揭示了在构建PRS和进行长度扩展时，必须使用相干访问（coherent access），从而指出了现有黑盒构造中访问模型的关键区别，具有重要的密码学理论价值。
motivation: 探讨在量子密码学中，从量子安全的一路函数（OWF）构建伪随机态（PRS）时，预言机的访问模型（经典可访问与相干访问）所扮演的角色和必要性。
method: 构造相对的量子预言机，其中存在量子安全的一路函数（OWF），但对于超对数输出长度不存在伪随机态（PRS），并分析了经典可访问预言机与相干访问的区别。
results: 证明了存在相对的预言机，使得量子安全OWF存在但超对数输出长度的PRS不存在；同时证明了对数输出长度的伪随机函数态（PRFS）在此类预言机下存在，从而分离了对数长度PRFS与超对数长度PRS，并证明PRS长度扩展必须使用相干访问。
conclusion: 论文证明了超对数输出长度的PRS无法仅通过经典可访问预言机由量子安全OWF构造，强调了在量子密码学构造中相干访问（coherent access）的必要性。

title: Verifiable Quantum Advantage and Computation via Quantum Circuit Obfuscation
authors: Alexandru Gheorghiu, Aparna Gupte, Vojtěch Havlíček, Yunchao Liu
abstract:
We construct protocols for classically verifiable quantum advantage and classical verification of $\mathsf{BQP}$ computations using \emph{quantum indistinguishability obfuscation} (qiO). Specifically, given qiO and assuming a slightly stronger version of $\mathsf{BQP}\neq\mathsf{BPP}$, we construct a two-message quantum-advantage protocol that is efficiently and publicly verifiable. Our result can be viewed as a rigorous cryptographic foundation for the heuristic quantum advantage proposals based on \emph{peaked random circuit sampling} of Aaronson and Zhang (arXiv:2404.14493).
  We also construct two simple protocols for classically verifying arbitrary $\mathsf{BQP}$ computations. The first protocol is privately verifiable and assumes only the existence of qiO. This gives a rare example of a nontrivial cryptographic application of (quantum) iO that does not make additional computational hardness assumptions. The second protocol additionally assumes post-quantum one-way functions and is \emph{publicly verifiable}. To our knowledge, this is the first publicly verifiable protocol for classical verification of $\mathsf{BQP}$ computations under computational assumptions in the standard model.
  We show that all our results hold when qiO is assumed only for ancilla-free unitary circuits. As evidence supporting this assumption, we prove a worst-to-average-case reduction for obfuscating such circuits. This reduction extends the local-mixing framework of Canetti, Chamon, Mucciolo and Ruckenstein (TCC 2024) under quantum analogues of their assumptions.
zh_title: 可验证的量子优势和通过量子电路混淆的计算
translation:
我们提出了使用

量子不可区分混淆（qiO）

来实现可经典验证的量子优势和可经典验证的

$\\mathsf{BQP}$

计算的协议。具体来说，给定qiO并假设一个略强的

$\\mathsf{BQP}\\neq\\mathsf{BPP}$

版本，我们构建了一个两消息的量子优势协议，该协议是可高效且公开验证的。我们的结果可以被视为对Aaronson和Zhang（arXiv:2404.14493）提出的基于

峰值随机电路采样

的启发式量子优势提案的严格密码学基础。

我们还构建了两个用于经典验证任意

$\\mathsf{BQP}$

计算的简单协议。第一个协议是私有可验证的，并且仅假设qiO的存在。这提供了一个罕见的（量子）iO的非平凡密码学应用的例子，而无需额外的计算困难性假设。第二个协议还假设了后量子单向函数，并且是

公开可验证的

。据我们所知，这是在标准模型下基于计算假设的第一个公开可验证的经典验证

$\\mathsf{BQP}$

计算的协议。

我们表明，当qiO仅对无辅助酉电路假设时，我们所有的结果都成立。作为支持这一假设的证据，我们证明了对这类电路进行混淆的最坏情况到平均情况的约简。该约简在他们的假设的量子类似物下，扩展了Canetti、Chamon、Mucciolo和Ruckenstein（TCC 2024）的局部混合框架。
tldr: 该研究提出了使用量子不可区分混淆（qiO）来构建可经典验证的量子优势和BQP计算验证协议。
ai_comments: 该研究在量子计算验证领域取得了重要进展，特别是利用量子不可区分混淆（qiO）构建了可验证的量子优势和BQP计算验证协议。其亮点在于提供了严格的密码学基础，并探索了qiO在标准模型下的应用。然而，协议的实际实现和效率仍需进一步研究。
motivation: 为启发式量子优势提案（如Aaronson和Zhang提出的峰值随机电路采样）提供严格的密码学基础，并探索qiO在验证量子计算中的应用。
method: 利用量子不可区分混淆（qiO）技术，构建了两种类型的协议：一种是实现量子优势且可公开验证的两消息协议；另一种是用于经典验证任意BQP计算的协议，其中一种是私有可验证的，另一种是公开可验证的（需要后量子单向函数）。
results: 成功构建了可经典验证的量子优势协议和BQP计算验证协议。其中，私有可验证协议仅需qiO，公开可验证协议需qiO和后量子单向函数。研究还证明了在ancilla-free酉电路的qiO假设下，这些结果同样成立，并提供了支持该假设的约简证明。
conclusion: 该研究为量子优势和BQP计算的验证提供了新的密码学方法，并展示了量子不可区分混淆（qiO）在其中的关键作用，为未来的量子计算验证研究奠定了基础。

title: Conditioning-Free Non-Uniform Quantum Fourier and Chebyshev Transforms
authors: Chaowen Guan, Akshit Katiyar
abstract: We present an efficient quantum algorithm for the non-uniform Chebyshev transform. It is defined as the projection of a function onto Chebyshev polynomials sampled at given nodes that are uniform in $x\in[-1,1]$, and hence non-uniform in the angle $θ=\arccos x$, a setting that QFT-based quantum Chebyshev transforms cannot handle. Our construction is based on an improvement of an existing Non-uniform Quantum Fourier Transform (NUQFT) whereby we remove the conditioning from non-uniform node sampling. Hence, error bounds are independent of the geometry-dependent parameter $κ$ of prior work. We use the fact that Chebyshev transform matrix is the average of two Type-II non-uniform DFTs, which we implement with a single controlled NUQFT circuit. We provide explicit oracle constructions, including the row-access oracle previously left as an assumption. The resulting $\varepsilon$-accurate block encoding has $O(1)$ normalization and uses $O(L)$ qubits and $\widetilde O(L^2)$ gates, where $L=\log N+\log(1/\varepsilon)$. We give an end-to-end implementation with complexity analysis, including the success probability and output-state error.

title: Planted Cliques and Quantum Symmetry-Adapted Measurements
authors: Vojtech Havlicek, Jordan Docter, Subhash Khot
abstract: The planted clique problem is a promising candidate for quantum advantage with a wide computational-statistical gap and substantial evidence for classical hardness. We study two quantum encodings of classical samples, a natural binary phase state encoding and symmetry-adapted measurements, and determine if they preserve enough information for planted-clique detection, as well as discuss their potential towards algorithmic efficiency. For the binary phase state encoding, we show that constant-advantage detection requires $Ω(n^{1+2\varepsilon}\ln^2 n)$ copies, even under arbitrary joint measurements. Measurements on $\tilde{O}(n^2)$ copies suffice statistically above the logarithmic clique threshold. The symmetry-adapted measurements on the full graph register arise naturally from the Schur transform. We show that the outcome distribution of weak Schur sampling depends on the sampled graph only through its edge count and fails to distinguish the distributions; whereas retaining the representation label and Specht register after discarding multiplicity preserves distance $1-o(1)$. Near-perfect distinguishability survives even if the label is also discarded. We calculate the retained states, providing concrete targets for efficient measurement. Finally, we show that one supplied coherent quantum sample enables an efficient quantum distinguisher, which yields a conditional computational separation from one classical sample under quantum planted-clique hardness. Our results are structural and information-theoretic; efficient detection from one classical graph in the conjectured hard regime remains open.
zh_title: 置信团与量子对称适应测量
translation: 置信团问题是实现量子优势的一个有前景的候选问题，具有广泛的计算-统计鸿沟和大量的经典困难性证据。我们研究了经典样本的两种量子编码——自然的二进制相位状态编码和对称适应测量，确定它们是否保留了足够的信息来进行置信团检测，并讨论了它们在算法效率方面的潜力。对于二进制相位状态编码，我们表明即使在任意联合测量下，常数优势检测也需要 $\Omega(n^{1+2\varepsilon}\ln^2 n)$ 个副本。在对数团阈值之上，$\tilde{O}(n^2)$ 个副本的测量在统计上是足够的。完整图寄存器上的对称适应测量自然地由舒尔变换产生。我们证明了弱舒尔采样的结果分布仅通过其边数依赖于所采样的图，且无法区分这些分布；而保留表示标签和Specht寄存器（在丢弃多重性之后）保持了 $1-o(1)$ 的距离。即使也丢弃了标签，近乎完美的区分度依然存在。我们计算了保留的状态，为高效测量提供了具体的靶标。最后，我们表明提供的一个相干量子样本能够实现一个高效的量子区分器，在量子置信团困难性的假设下，这产生了一个与一个经典样本的条件计算分离。我们的结果是结构性的和信息论的；在被推测为困难的区间内，从一个经典图中进行高效检测仍然是一个开放问题。
tldr: 论文研究了置信团问题中的量子编码与对称适应测量，揭示了其样本复杂度、信息保留能力及量子优势潜力。
ai_comments: 该论文研究了置信团问题中的量子编码与对称适应测量，在结构和信息论层面上探讨了实现量子优势的可能性，指出了不同编码和测量方案的样本复杂度和区分能力。
motivation: 置信团问题是探索量子优势的一个有前途的候选问题，具备广泛的计算-统计鸿沟和经典的困难性证据。作者旨在研究两种经典样本的量子编码及其对称适应测量，评估它们在保留置信团检测信息方面的能力及算法效率的潜力。
method: 研究了两种量子编码（二进制相位状态编码和对称适应测量），分析了二进制相位状态编码下常数优势检测所需的样本副本数，并运用舒尔变换和弱舒尔采样分析了对称适应测量的结果分布与区分能力。
results: 二进制相位状态编码在常数优势检测下需要 $\Omega(n^{1+2\varepsilon}\ln^2 n)$ 个副本，而 $\tilde{O}(n^2)$ 个副本在统计上足够；弱舒尔采样无法区分，但保留表示标签和Specht寄存器或进一步丢弃标签后仍能保持接近完美的区分度；一个相干量子样本可实现高效的量子区分器。
conclusion: 论文通过结构和信息论分析，揭示了不同量子编码和测量方案在置信团问题中的表现，证明了相干量子样本可以实现高效的量子区分器，但从一个经典图中进行高效检测仍是个开放问题。

title: Solving Sparse SDPs in Sublinear Time: A Classical Algorithm Inspired by the Quantum OR Lemma
authors: Fernando G.S.L. Brandão, Alexander M. Dalzell, András Gilyén, Francisca Vasconcelos
abstract:
We give the first sublinear-time classical solvers for sparse semidefinite programs in the bounded-radius regime, without low-rank assumptions or Frobenius norm dependence on the constraint matrices. For constant precision and bounded primal and dual radii, prior quantum algorithms of Brandão et al. (2019) and van Apeldoorn and Gilyén (2019) achieved $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{n}+\sqrt{m})$ dependence on matrix dimension $n$ and constraint number $m$. Compared with the $\widetilde{O}(mn)$ runtime of existing classical methods, this suggests a quartic quantum speedup when $m \approx n$. Beyond a usual Grover speedup, this separation relies on the Quantum OR lemma, whose sample-reuse mechanism decouples the cost of Gibbs-state preparation from constraint search. We show that this reuse mechanism is classically realizable for sparse SDPs.
  Our main technical contribution is a classical procedure for simultaneously estimating many expectation values with respect to a sparse Hamiltonian's Gibbs state. This combines randomized Lánczos filtering with an efficient sampling-based estimator. We also introduce a stochastic online-learning framework for SDP solving, substantially improving accuracy-dependence over standard oracle-based MMWU approaches. Let $s$ denote the the input matrix sparsity and $γ:=Rr/\varepsilon$ capture dependence on the primal $(R)$ and dual $(r)$ radii as well as target accuracy $(\varepsilon)$. When $γ^2\leq\min\{m,n/s\}$, our solver runs in time $\widetilde{O}\left(nsγ^{4.5}+msγ^2\right)$. For $γ=O(1)$, this is $\widetilde{O}\left((n+m)s\right)$ and sublinear in the $O(mns)$ input size. Similar to the quantum algorithms, this matches known lower bounds with respect to $m$ and $n$, up to logarithmic factors. This implies that, with respect to dimensions $m$ and $n$, there is no super-quadratic quantum advantage for generic sparse SDP solving.
zh_title: 在亚线性时间内求解稀疏SDP：受量子OR引理启发的经典算法
translation:
我们针对有界半径体制下的稀疏半定规划（SDP），给出了首个亚线性时间的经典求解器，且无需低秩假设或约束矩阵的弗罗贝尼乌斯范数依赖。对于常数精度以及有界的主对偶半径，Brandão等人（2019）和van Apeldoorn与Gilyén（2019）先前的量子算法实现了对矩阵维度 $n$ 和约束数量 $m$ 的 $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{n}+\sqrt{m})$ 依赖。与现有经典方法 $\widetilde{O}(mn)$ 的运行时间相比，当 $m \approx n$ 时，这暗示了四次方的量子加速。除了常规的Grover加速外，这种性能差距依赖于量子OR引理，其样本复用机制将吉布斯态制备的成本与约束搜索解耦。我们证明了这种复用机制对于稀疏SDP是可经典实现的。
我们主要的理论贡献是一个经典程序，用于同时估计稀疏哈密顿量吉布斯态的许多期望值。这结合了随机兰索斯滤波（randomized Lánczos filtering）与高效的基于采样的估计器。我们还引入了一个用于SDP求解的随机在线学习框架，显著改善了标准基于预言机的MMWU方法的精度依赖关系。令 $s$ 表示输入矩阵的稀疏度，$\gamma := Rr/\varepsilon$ 表示对原半径 $(R)$、对偶半径 $(r)$ 以及目标精度 $(\varepsilon)$ 的依赖。当 $\gamma^2\leq\min\{m,n/s\}$ 时，我们的求解器运行时间为 $\widetilde{O}\left(ns\gamma^{4.5}+ms\gamma^2\right)$。对于 $\gamma=O(1)$，时间复杂度为 $\widetilde{O}\left((n+m)s\right)$，相对于 $O(mns)$ 的输入规模而言是亚线性的。类似于量子算法，在对数因子范围内，这与关于 $m$ 和 $n$ 的已知下界相匹配。这意味着，就维度 $m$ 和 $n$ 而言，对于通用的稀疏SDP求解，并不存在超二次的量子优势。
tldr: 论文提出了首个求解稀疏SDP的亚线性时间经典算法，证明了求解稀疏SDP并不存在超二次的量子优势。
ai_comments: 该论文打破了“量子算法在求解稀疏SDP时具有超二次加速”的传统认知，通过借鉴量子OR引理中的样本复用机制，首次在经典计算机上实现了稀疏SDP的亚线性时间求解，具有极高的理论价值。
motivation: 先前的工作表明量子算法在求解稀疏半定规划（SDP）时相比传统经典方法具有四次方加速，这种加速不仅依赖于Grover加速，还依赖于量子OR引理的样本复用机制。论文旨在探讨这种样本复用机制是否能在经典算法中实现，从而重新审视量子算法在SDP求解上的优势。
method: 结合了随机兰索斯滤波与高效的基于采样的估计器，提出了一种经典程序来同时估计稀疏哈密顿量吉布斯态的多个期望值；同时引入了用于SDP求解的随机在线学习框架。
results: 在 $γ^2\leq\min\{m,n/s\}$ 的条件下，求解器的时间复杂度为 $\widetilde{O}\left(nsγ^{4.5}+msγ^2\right)$。当 $γ=O(1)$ 时，复杂度为 $\widetilde{O}\left((n+m)s\right)$，相对于输入大小是亚线性的，且在维度上匹配了已知的下界。
conclusion: 对于一般的稀疏半定规划问题，在维度 $m$ 和 $n$ 方面并不存在超二次的量子优势。

title: Explicit Capacity-Achieving Quantum LDPC Codes List Decodable in Near-linear Time
authors: William Gay, Fernando Granha Jeronimo, Abhi Shukul
abstract:
In classical coding theory, the quest for explicit codes achieving list decoding capacity has been an important driving force. While random codes are easily shown to achieve capacity, an explicit construction was only discovered decades later in the seminal work [Guruswami and Rudra, STOC 2006]. In quantum coding theory, it is highly desirable that a code family be LDPC. While good quantum codes were known for decades, obtaining the additional LDPC property was elusive. In fact, only very recently that good quantum LDPC codes were discovered in a breakthrough work [Panteleev and Kalachev, STOC 2022].
  In this context, a natural question is to ask for an explicit family of quantum codes achieving list decoding capacity while also possessing the important LDPC property. In this work, we provide (to the best of our knowledge) the first explicit constructions of quantum LDPC codes achieving list decoding capacity, namely, with a list decoding radius approaching the quantum Singleton bound with constant list sizes. Furthermore, we provide near-linear time (in the block-length) list decoding algorithms approaching capacity.
  Our explicit code construction are based on expander graphs via the quantum analogue of Alon-Edmonds-Luby (AEL) amplification [Bergamaschi, Golowich and Gunn, STOC 2024], and this enables the important LDPC property. Our efficient list decoding algorithms are obtained by generalizing the classical expander-based weak-regularity list decoding algorithms [Srivastava and Tulsiani, FOCS 2025] [Jeronimo and Singh, 2025] to suitable instantiations of quantum AEL.
zh_title: 可在近线性时间内进行列表译码的显式达到容量的量子LDPC码
translation:
在经典编码理论中，寻找实现列表译码容量的显式码一直是一个重要的驱动力。虽然随机码很容易被证明能实现容量，但直到几十年后，Guruswami和Rudra（STOC 2006）的开创性工作才发现了显式构造。在量子编码理论中，非常希望码族是LDPC的。虽然好的量子码已经存在了几十年，但获得额外的LDPC属性一直很难。事实上，直到最近在Panteleev和Kalachev（STOC 2022）的一项突破性工作中，才发现了好的量子LDPC码。
在这一背景下，一个自然的问题是寻找一类显式的量子码族，它既能实现列表译码容量，又具有重要的LDPC属性。在这项工作中，我们（据我们所知）首次显式构造了实现列表译码容量的量子LDPC码，即列表译码半径接近具有常数列表大小的量子Singleton界。此外，我们还提供了在块长度上呈近线性时间的、接近容量的列表译码算法。
我们的显式码构造基于通过Alon-Edmonds-Luby (AEL) 放大（Bergamaschi, Golowich和Gunn，STOC 2024）的量子模拟的扩张图，这实现了重要的LDPC属性。我们高效的列表译码算法是通过将经典的基于扩张图的弱正则列表译码算法（Srivastava和Tulsiani，FOCS 2025；Jeronimo和Singh，2025）推广到量子AEL的合适实例中获得的。
tldr: 本文首次显式构造了既能达到列表译码容量又具备近线性时间译码算法的量子LDPC码。
ai_comments: 该论文在量子编码理论中具有里程碑意义，首次显式构造了既具有量子LDPC性质又达到列表译码容量的量子纠错码，并且实现了近线性时间的译码算法，推动了量子纠错码向实用化迈进的关键一步。
motivation: 在经典编码理论中，显式构造达到列表译码容量的码已被广泛研究，而在量子编码理论中，寻找同时具有良好性质、LDPC特性以及达到容量的显式量子码族长期以来是一个开放性难题。本文旨在填补这一空白。
method: 基于扩张图，利用量子类比的 Alon-Edmonds-Luby (AEL) 放大技术实现LDPC性质；通过将经典基于扩张图的弱正则列表译码算法推广到适当的量子AEL实例中，设计高效的近线性时间列表译码算法。
results: 首次显式构造了达到量子Singleton界列表译码半径（具有常数列表大小）的量子LDPC码族，并给出了接近容量的近线性时间块长度列表译码算法。
conclusion: 本文成功给出了首个显式的、达到列表译码容量且具备近线性时间译码算法的量子LDPC码族。

title: Exponential quantum speedup for $\mathbb{F}_3^n$-Subset-Sum? Or, rigorous classical algorithms for Binary-Error LWE
authors: Robin Kothari, Tony Metger, Ryan O'Donnell, Noah Shutty, Kewen Wu
abstract:
We study vector subset sum over $\mathbb{F}_3^n$: given $m$ random vectors from $\mathbb{F}_3^n$, find a nonempty subset that sums to zero; the smaller $m$, the more difficult it is to find such a subset. Chen, Liu, and Zhandry (EUROCRYPT'22) introduced an efficient quantum algorithm that solves this problem when $m\approx n^2/2$, where a naive classical algorithm would require exponential time. Subsequently, Kothari, O'Donnell, and Wu (STOC'2026) gave an efficient classical algorithm that only requires $m \approx n^2/3$ vectors, thus removing the hope for an exponential quantum advantage in this parameter regime.
  Using the framework of Chen, Liu, and Zhandry, we give quantum algorithms that require much fewer input vectors, renewing the possibility of an exponential quantum speedup: for any fixed $ε>0$, our quantum algorithm solves $\mathbb{F}_3$-subset sum in polynomial time with $m=ε\cdot n^2$ vectors. More generally, we establish a full sample--time tradeoff that interpolates between exponential and polynomial runtime.
  The main ingredient is a deterministic classical algorithm for the binary-error Learning-with-Errors problem, which is of independent cryptographic interest. For this, we rigorously establish a sample--time tradeoff that was predicted by earlier algebraic heuristics. For vector subset sums over larger fields, we also significantly improve classical algorithms in Kothari, O'Donnell, and Wu (STOC'2026).
zh_title: $\mathbb{F}_3^n$-Subset-Sum的指数级量子加速？或者：针对二进制错误LWE的严格经典算法
translation:
我们研究了 $\mathbb{F}_3^n$ 上的向量子集和：给定来自 $\mathbb{F}_3^n$ 的 $m$ 个随机向量，找到一个和为零的非空子集；$m$ 越小，寻找这样的子集就越困难。Chen、Liu 和 Zhandry（EUROCRYPT'22）引入了一种高效的量子算法，当 $m \approx n^2/2$ 时可以解决此问题，而朴素的经典算法则需要指数时间。随后，Kothari、O'Donnell 和 Wu（STOC'2026）给出了一个高效的经典算法，只需要 $m \approx n^2/3$ 个向量，从而消除了在该参数范围内获得指数量子优势的希望。
利用 Chen、Liu 和 Zhandry 的框架，我们给出了需要更少输入向量的量子算法，重新燃起了实现指数级量子加速的可能性：对于任何固定的 $\varepsilon > 0$，我们的量子算法使用 $m=\varepsilon \cdot n^2$ 个向量在多项式时间内解决了 $\mathbb{F}_3$-子集和问题。更一般地，我们建立了一个完整的样本-时间权衡，在指数运行时间和多项式运行时间之间进行插值。
主要成分是针对二进制错误带误差学习（binary-error Lwe）问题的确定性经典算法，这具有独立的密码学兴趣。为此，我们严格建立了早期代数启发式预测的样本-时间权衡。对于更大域上的向量子集和，我们还显著改进了 Kothari、O'Donnell 和 Wu（STOC'2026）中的经典算法。
tldr: 本文通过提出新的量子算法和二进制错误LWE的经典算法，重新证明了$\mathbb{F}_3^n$-Subset-Sum问题存在指数级量子加速的可能。
ai_comments: 该论文重新探讨了$\mathbb{F}_3^n$-Subset-Sum问题中的量子优势，通过改进量子算法和建立更优的经典算法（针对binary-error LWE问题），在理论密码学和算法复杂度领域具有重要意义。
motivation: 此前Kothari等人的研究通过高效的经典算法消除了在 $m \approx n^2/3$ 参数区域内指数级量子优势的希望，本文旨在通过开发需要更少输入向量的新量子算法，重新探索并证明是否存在指数级的量子加速。
method: 利用Chen、Liu和Zhandry的框架开发需要更少输入向量的量子算法，并提出了解决二元错误带误差学习（binary-error LWE）问题的确定性经典算法。
